description: Land Aquisition - Kandegama, Udadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District. - Galewela, Galewela  D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and legal orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
